{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in customer_age
missing_age = sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum()

# Check the data type of customer_age
age_dtype = sales_df['customer_age'].dtype

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., negative ages, ages above 120)
sentinel_age = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_age'] < 0) | (sales_df['customer_age'] > 120)].shape[0]

missing_age, age_dtype, sentinel_age"}
